info.name: List supported couriers/carriers (MODELED - not found in public reference)

items.docs: Illustrative list of the courier/carrier network Parcel Perform tracks against (reported between roughly 900 and 1,000+ carriers worldwide per Parcel Perform's marketing pages). No standalone `/courier` endpoint is documented in the public API Guides & Reference as of this review; carrier codes otherwise only appear as a field on Shipment resources. Entirely modeled.
